description: tangram is a modular platform for research with ADS-B and Mode S flight-surveillance data. A Python or Rust backend collects, stores and processes messages, while a JavaScript web interface presents results and accepts plugins. The JOSS summary names uses such as turbulence and GNSS-interference detection, aviation-weather studies, emissions analysis and airport-performance monitoring. Its geographic coverage and time span depend on the surveillance receivers or feeds supplied by the user; the platform is not a complete global flight dataset. The own repository and documentation site are public under AGPL-3.0. It can prepare observed traffic streams for air-traffic modelling and compare patterns during a disruption. A caveat is that surveillance coverage and message quality vary by region, and a plugin can make its own assumptions that need checking. The repository did not expose a README at the common root filename, so this review used the project documentation and article description. No directly related catalogue record was established. It was not deployed and no live surveillance data were collected.
name: tangram air traffic research platform
notes: G5 G5-0664. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
